intro: I'm a final-year software engineering student at INSAT in Tunis, and most of what I build sits where product engineering meets AI and infrastructure. On the product side, I ship full-stack applications with React/Next.js and FastAPI or Node. On the AI side, I design RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems with LangChain and LangGraph — from document ingestion and chunking strategy to retrieval and evaluation. On the infrastructure side, I work with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka and observability stacks like Prometheus and Loki, which is what my Kubemind project builds on. Beyond code, I've led student teams of up to 40 people and organized events with 1,500+ participants, so I'm comfortable owning a project end to end and working across roles. I'm looking for an end-of-studies internship starting February 2027, ideally in Europe, in software engineering, AI engineering or SRE/DevOps.
